map.根据使用场景和患者年龄，计算简易呼吸器（球囊面罩）的通气频率、潮气量和挤压节奏，: Computes bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilation rate, tidal volume and squeeze rhythm by scenario and patient age, with a metronome guide.
map.通气频率按场景与年龄取值：成人 10 至 12 次/分（CPR 中固定 10 次: Rates by scenario and age: adult 10-12/min (fixed 10/min during CPR), child 12-20/min, infant 20-30/min; tidal volume about 6-7 mL/kg or 1/2-1/3 bag squeeze; squeeze:relax 1:1 to 1:2, each squeeze about 1 s.
map.按压节拍引导（点击下方按钮启动/停止）: Compression metronome (click the button below to start/stop)
map.EC手法固定面罩，仰额抬颏开放气道，每次挤压约1秒，观察胸廓起伏确认有效通气。: EC-clamp the mask, head-tilt/chin-lift to open the airway, squeeze about 1 s each time, watch chest rise to confirm effective ventilation.
map.注意：避免过度通气！过度通气会导致胸内压升高、回心血量减少、心输出量下降。CPR: Note: avoid hyperventilation! It raises intrathoracic pressure, reduces venous return and lowers cardiac output. During CPR, compressions and ventilation must not run together.
map.成人心脏骤停 CPR 时，按 30:2 比例设定球囊通气 10–12 次/分，避: For adult cardiac-arrest CPR, set BVM ventilation 10-12/min at a 30:2 ratio, avoiding hyperventilation.
map.婴幼儿呼吸骤停，按 12–20 次/分、小潮气量（仅胸廓抬起）轻柔挤压，防止胃胀: For infant respiratory arrest, 12-20/min with small tidal volume (chest just rising), gentle squeeze to prevent gastric distension.
map.有自主节律但通气不足者，按血氧与: For those with spontaneous rhythm but hypoventilation, adjust assisted
map.输入患者类别=成人、按压周期 30:2，工具给出通气 10–12 次/分、每次挤: Input patient=adult, cycle 30:2; the tool gives 10-12/min and 1/3 bag per squeeze, consistent with AHA guidance.
map.本工具能替代抢救时医师指令吗？: Can this tool replace the physician's rescue orders?
map.不能，仅作参数复核，实际通气以抢救团队指挥与胸廓起伏观察为准。: No; it only checks parameters. Actual ventilation follows the rescue team lead and chest-rise observation.
map.挤压后胃胀气明显怎么办？: What if gastric distension is obvious after squeezing?
map.降低潮气量至仅胸廓抬起，抬高下颌开放气道，必要时置口咽通气管。: Lower tidal volume to just chest rise, lift the jaw to open the airway, and place an oropharyngeal airway if needed.
map.有氧源时如何调整？: How to adjust with an oxygen source?
map.连接储氧袋可将 FiO2 提至近 100%，频率不变，仍应避免过度通气。: Connect a reservoir bag to raise FiO2 near 100%; rate unchanged, still avoid hyperventilation.

map.按患者年龄设定球囊面罩人工呼吸频率与潮气量参考，辅助 CPR 通气参数核对。: Sets BVM artificial-ventilation rate and tidal-volume reference by age to aid CPR parameter checks.
